subject.title: Provider cost history for Anthropic and OpenAI Admin APIs

question: Should OpenClaw extend the provider usage contract now to include Anthropic/OpenAI Admin API daily cost history, and which Admin API credential precedence should be accepted?
rationale: The code path is clear, but this adds public provider SDK shape, new Admin API env variables, sensitive billing data handling, and UI behavior that automation should not decide under a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Sponsor provider-history contract
options.body: Add one generic history shape, plugin-owned Anthropic/OpenAI Admin API fetchers, and Usage card rendering while preserving existing subscription quota snapshots when Admin credentials are absent.

options.title: Prototype plugin-owned history first
options.body: Keep core fields unchanged initially and prove provider-owned Admin API collection behind the existing usage hook before committing to the UI and SDK history shape.

options.title: Defer Admin API billing
options.body: Leave provider Admin API history outside OpenClaw for now and keep the current subscription/quota and session-estimated cost surfaces.

recommendation.title: Sponsor provider-history contract
recommendation.body: Add one generic history shape, plugin-owned Anthropic/OpenAI Admin API fetchers, and Usage card rendering while preserving existing subscription quota snapshots when Admin credentials are absent.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current issue assignment and recently authored the provider usage/billing foundation this request extends.
